item.title: Man arrested after Interstate 20 crash
item.description: A Ruston man involved in a crash on Interstate 20 in Bienville Parish was charged with DWI and possession of marijuana and other charges last week. item.title: Nine dead in Louisiana due to cold, ice storm
item.description: by Wesley Harris The Louisiana Department of Health confirmed nine Louisianans died as the result of Ice Storm Fern last week. According to LDH, the deaths included six for hypothermia, one for carbon monoxide poisoning, one for oxygen deprivation, and one due to a traffic crash. The deaths were confirmed by parish coroners as storm-related. … Continue reading Nine dead in Louisiana due to cold, ice storm
